rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A LinkedIn job search server that provides comprehensive job discovery and filtering capabilities without requiring authentication. Built using web scraping techniques with Axios and Cheerio, it offers specialized tools including keyword-based job search, remote job filtering, entry-level position discovery, detailed job information retrieval, and company research. The implementation supports advanced filtering by location, experience level, workplace type (remote/hybrid/on-site), date posted, and Easy Apply options, while also providing helper functions for popular locations, industries, and job functions.
